_: Text under "More" for each tool in VE Manager 0.7+ and the support note. Edit and save - no new VE Manager needed. Text only (no pictures, no video). Lists = one line per point, "en" and "pl" (English shows when Polish is missing). Tool keys as in ve-tools.json: clean, scene_doctor, pivot, measure, gutter, panels, roof. Parts of a tool: how (numbered steps), tips, new (what's new; when missing the release notes show), plan (what we plan), links [{"title": {"en", "pl"}, "url", "url_pl"}]. Missing parts are not shown. support.every = the note shows on every N-th opening of VE Manager (people can switch it off in Settings).
